personal.name: Nam Nguyen
personal.title: AI Research Engineer at FPT Software AI Center
personal.bio: Thank you for visiting! I am an AI Research Engineer with nearly two years of hands-on experience in Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) algorithms. Currently, I work at FPT Software AI Center, contributing to both research and engineering projects. My expertise spans developing and optimizing Vision-Language Models, designing advanced AI agents, and building benchmarking frameworks such as LibMoE and CodeMMLU. I am passionate about creating <highlight>more efficient algorithms for LLMs (make them cheaper but with better accuracy)</highlight> and building <highlight>agentic systems for task automation (make them intelligent to decrease human intervention)</highlight>. While I enjoy exploring cutting-edge research papers, I dedicate even more time to implementing and coding innovative solutions.

news.content: Our paper SemViQA has been accepted at ACL 2026 Industry Track!
Recognition Award for Remarkable Potential and Excellent Performance
Announcing the release of CompeteSMoE++ — our next-generation SMoE algorithm!
Our paper CodeMMLU has been accepted at ICLR 2025!
Graduated from IUH with a Bachelor's degree in Data Science (CGPA: 3.65/4), completing the program one year early!
We released LibMoE: a new framework for training and validating Sparse Mixture of Experts models!
We released CodeMMLU: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Assessing Code Understanding Capabilities!
Joined FPT Software AI Center as an AI Research Engineer.
The new SemViQA upgrade achieved the top position on the private leaderboard, delivering 7x faster inference speed. Explore our technical report: arxiv.org/abs/2503.00955
Founded CW Lab, a student-led university startup lab developing speech-to-speech translation technology to break global language barriers, alongside four peers under senior engineer mentorship.
Encouragement Prize at UIT Challenge 2023 Competition with our Vietnamese fact-checking framework SemViQA!
Awarded the Second Prize at the 31st Vietnam Student Informatics Olympiad.
Started my studies in Data Science at IUH with a CGPA of 3.87/4.
Began my journey at the Information Technology Department of IUH, Vietnam.
